title: Balanced FKN lift
statement: For a Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, define a Boolean function on the $(n+1)$-dimensional sign cube by sending $z$ to the product of $z_0$ and $f$ evaluated at the vector whose $i$th coordinate is $z_0z_{i+1}$, for $0\le i<n$.
